climate_tree.source: MCP Overworld rules with Bedrock quantization, ordered by the native BDS tree builder

aquifer.source: native BDS fluid-level and barrier routines with seeded noise, MCP terrain splines and prescribed preliminary surfaces

terrain_columns.source: native BDS terrain columns and unblended preliminary-surface search with seeded noise and MCP terrain splines

caves.source: native BDS cave graph with seeded MCP noise definitions and native Overworld context parameters
caves.math_library_limit: The reference runner bridges powf to host libm. Go's widened pillar cube matched the sampled cave queries, but a separate exhaustive mantissa check found 5626 bitwise differences in 8388608 positive float32 inputs from 1 through the predecessor of 2.

noise_cell_overflow.source: native BDS normal-noise sampling around signed cell-index conversion boundaries
